page_title: FIO 3-2 BOL | Fiorentina v Bologna 18/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Here's the latest number of offsides – 4:1.
90+3' Luca Zufferli blows for a foul after Dodo (Fiorentina) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
90+1' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) is coming onto the pitch as Nicolo Fagioli cannot continue after picking up an injury.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
88' Juan Miranda (Bologna) receives a red card due to his mindless behaviour. His team will now have to play with a man down.
87' Here comes a substitution. Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) is brought on as a substitute for Marin Pongracic.
84' 3 - 2 Goal! Moise Kean (Fiorentina) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 3:2.

84' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score low in the middle of the goal, but great anticipation by Lukasz Skorupski allowed him to make a comfortable save.
83' The statistic for corner kicks – 2:4.
80' It's time for a substitution. Emil Holm (Bologna) comes on in place of Davide Calabria.
80' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to make a change. Nikola Moro (Bologna) replaces Remo Freuler.
79' 2 - 2 Goal! Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a low shot into the middle of the net. He makes it 2:2.
78' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Luca Zufferli has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
77' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
77' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) is the one who receives a yellow card.
76' Juan Miranda (Bologna) drills in an effort from the edge of the box that climbs rapidly and goes high over the bar.
74' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) is able to continue to play.
72' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) picks up an injury.
69' Total attempts – 1:11.
67' 2 - 1 Goal! The rebound fell to Amir Richardson (Fiorentina) and he fired home from close range. The score is 2:1.
65' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) has tested the patience of referee Luca Zufferli and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
64' Luca Zufferli sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
63' The Bologna players celebrate the goal but the referee immediately signals a VAR review. Let's see what happens. Big moment in the game.

61' 1 - 1 Goal – 1:1! Riccardo Orsolini sends a precise lofted pass into the box, Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) rises above the defenders to meet the ball near the penalty spot and heads it straight into the left side of the goal.
59' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Nicolo Casale (Bologna).
57' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Luca Zufferli blows his whistle for a foul.
56' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) replacing Nicolo Cambiaghi.
56' Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Giovanni Fabbian.
55' The linesman signals that Juan Miranda (Bologna) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
53' Juan Miranda (Bologna) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Luca Zufferli blows his whistle for a foul.
52' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) is adjudged offside.
50' Amir Richardson (Fiorentina) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
48' It looks like Nicolo Casale (Bologna) saw red with that tackle. Luca Zufferli won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
46' Half-time substitution. Santiago Castro will not participate anymore and Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) is coming on.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Luca Zufferli blows for a foul.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
44' PENALTY APPEAL by Fiorentina, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
42' The referee blows his whistle as Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina) was too aggressive in his challenge.
40' Fiorentina failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
39' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Pietro Comuzzo limps off the pitch to be replaced by Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina).
37' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) commits a rough foul. Luca Zufferli stops the game and makes a call.
35' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) fails to beat a perfect example of the offside trap.
34' Juan Miranda (Bologna) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
33' The Fiorentina players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
31' Luca Zufferli has a clear sight and sees a foul from Dodo (Fiorentina).
30' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bologna.
28' 36:64 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
25' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
23' Bologna continue the game with a quickly taken free kick.
20' Luca Zufferli shows a yellow card to Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) for his blatant foul.
20' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) cuts inside after a good run and goes for glory from the edge of the box. The shot, though, flies high over the bar into row Z.
19' Flag up against Moise Kean (Fiorentina). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
17' Corner kick. Bologna will have an opportunity.
16' Bologna have been awarded a corner kick.
13' 1 - 0 Goal! Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the middle of the net.
11' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
8' Bologna force a corner. They send men into the box.
5' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
3' Fiorentina are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
